args.body: If you have already selected an original award record, continue with it. If selection is still open, use products/services/awarded-supplier-qa/award-brief-source-pointers.json if the queued extraction commits. Use its links and passages to locate the saved original award, then verify the exact obligation in that record. The extraction uses the local brief and consumes none of the two supplier-page FETCHes. Use those on the supplier's own documented invitation and response route. If both conditions are evidenced, run the buyer-specific acceptance controls and save the operator response under the existing mission.
